changelog: **MARKETING: setup checklist guides and document search in sales wording:** the "Getting started" checklist's help texts (`checklist.guides.*`) and the rep capacity step, plus the document-requirements candidate search, still explained the product in mentor/mentee/internship terms to a MARKETING tenant. All 16 guides get a MARKETING overlay in EN/TR/DE (lead / sales rep / account / deal); the leak ratchet drops by 16 per locale (en 398 · tr 401 · de 396).

en: The setup checklist's help texts now speak in leads, sales reps and deals instead of mentoring terms.
